  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 1, 2024
  4901 E. CARSON STREET
  LONG BEACH CITY COLLEGE,
  LIBERAL ARTS CAMPUS BUILDING T, ROOM 1100, 5:00 PM

Richard Lewis, Chair  Susana Gonzalez Edmond, Commissioner
Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Josh LaFarga, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PARKING INFORMATION

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-51918  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-51920  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, January 18, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-51968  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-23-149; and

  Approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP22-021) and Local Coastal Development
  Permit (LCDP22-031), and adopt the proposed findings and conditions of approval
  related thereto, to allow off-premise sales of alcoholic beverages, Alcoholic
  Beverage Control (ABC) Type 20 License for off-sale of beer and wine, at an
  existing gasoline station and convenience store located at 6401 East Pacific Coast
  Highway in the Mixed-Use Community Core (MU-CC) designation of the Southeast
  Area Specific Plan (SP-2). (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-51970  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE23-159 and approve

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 1, 2024
  4901 E. CARSON STREET
  LONG BEACH CITY COLLEGE,
  LIBERAL ARTS CAMPUS BUILDING T, ROOM 1100, 5:00 PM

  Conditional Use Permit (CUP23-021) to allow off-site alcohol sales (Alcoholic
  Beverage Control License Type 21 – Beer, Wine, and Distilled Spirits) for an El
  Super grocery store proposed within an existing 59,300-square-foot commercial
  tenant space located at 2185 South Street within the Regional Highway District
  (CHW) Zoning District. (District 9)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-51969  Recommendation to request that the City Council adopt a resolution accepting the
  Fountain/Wehrle Sustainable Communities Project Exemption (SCPE) pursuant to
  Chapter 4.2 of the Public Resources Code, Sections 21155 through 21155.4; and

  Recommend that the City Council adopt a Resolution approving a General Plan
  Map Amendment (GPA22-001) from Founding Contemporary Neighborhood (FCN)
  to Neighborhood Serving Commercial (NSC-M) / 4 Stories; and

  Recommend that the City Council declare an Ordinance approving a Zone Change
  (ZCHG22-005) from Two Family Residential District (R-2-N) with standard lots to
  Community R-4-N Commercial (CCN) which allows medium density residential
  development pursuant to R-4-N densities on properties located at 4151 Fountain
  Street and 4220 Wehrle Court. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-51967  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on potential amendments to
  the zoning code as an omnibus package of minor amendments designed to better
  facilitate planning and development of affordable housing and homeless services
  citywide, based on lessons learned from the homeless emergency period.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
